description: Saved prism L446.7 D147.1, backward PO, wavelength 0.532, m=1.3116.
analytic_controls: Saved per-angle polarization weights applied before level subtraction.
precision: 17 significant digits; eight complete replicas, all 16 Mueller entries.
scope: Low/high saved estimators use different prefix lengths and mixed cutoff history. They test acceptance of a changed correction, not cutoff-isolated bias or an exact half-prefix optical identity. No new optical runs.
format: Header: angle_count, levels, seeds, elements. Per angle: theta; then low and high: three counts, level-major seed-major matrix rows; expected complete mean, scaled Student-t halfwidths, Fieller halfwidths.
